definitions.explanation: A series of images and sensations during sleep.
A hope or ambition for the future.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}{変|へん}な{夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I had a strange dream last night.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}の{中|なか}で{空|そら}を{飛|と}んでいた。
examples.english: I was flying in my dream.

examples.japanese: {怖|こわ}い{夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}て、{夜中|よなか}に{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた。
examples.english: I woke up in the middle of the night after having a scary dream.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{同|おな}じ{夢|ゆめ}を{何度|なんど}も{見|み}るので、{不思議|ふしぎ}に{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: I've been having the same dream repeatedly since childhood, and I find it mysterious.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}になるのが{夢|ゆめ}です。
examples.english: My dream is to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}を{諦|あきら}めないでください。
examples.english: Please don't give up on your dream.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ}がやっと{叶|かな}った。
examples.english: My long-held dream finally came true.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さい{頃|ころ}からの{夢|ゆめ}だった{会社|かいしゃ}に{入|はい}ることができて、とても{嬉|うれ}しい。
examples.english: I'm very happy that I was able to join the company I'd dreamed of since I was little.

notes:
{夢|ゆめ} has two meanings: dreams during sleep and aspirations/ambitions.

SLEEP DREAMS:
- {夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}る: to have a dream (NOT {夢|ゆめ}がある)
- {悪夢|あくむ}: nightmare
- {夢|ゆめ}の{中|なか}で: in a dream

ASPIRATIONS:
- {夢|ゆめ}がある: to have a dream/goal
- {夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}う: dream comes true
- {夢|ゆめ}を{諦|あきら}める: to give up on a dream
- {夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}いかける: to chase a dream

COMPOUNDS:
- {夢中|むちゅう}: absorbed, engrossed
- {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}: daydream
- {初夢|はつゆめ}: first dream of the new year

IDIOM:
{夢|ゆめ}のよう: dreamlike, too good to be true
